brief: A restrained, precise identity for a native macOS screenshot utility. Approved concept A.
criteria: Readable in one color and at 16 px; preserve the approved open-corner silhouette.

concepts.name: Open corner
concepts.idea: Open a corner. Take a frame.
rationale: One distinctive interruption in a familiar boundary.
Blue in the app; monochrome in the menu bar.
Vector outlines without font or image dependencies.

next_steps: Verify in the actual menu bar and Dock.
